# Platform administrator

<!-- Generated by scripts/role-guides.ts. Edit the script, not this file. -->

You administer the platform. Use a business role for business work.

## Signing in

Open the workbench and sign in with your work account. The menu shows only what your role may use. If something you need is missing, ask your administrator about your role rather than borrowing another account: everything is recorded against the person signed in.

## What you do here

### Feature flags

Feature flags: switch capabilities by account.

### Operations

Events & deliveries, Audit trail verification, and the data platform loads through the API.

## Your screens

| Menu | Screen | What it is for |
|---|---|---|
| Overview | Home | Your workspace and items that need attention. |
| Overview | Work queue | Referrals, agent work and failed deliveries waiting for a person, with timers and owners. |
| Overview | Find a policy | Search by policy number, traveller, account or trip. |
| Partners | Accounts | Travel sellers, card issuers and banks that sell or provide cover. |
| Partners | Webhooks | Signed event notifications sent to partner systems. |
| Product & compliance | Forms & schedules | Filed forms and schedules, editions and their variable maps. |
| Product & compliance | Plans | Base, state and account plans: build, approve, test and publish. |
| Product & compliance | Licences | Retailer registrations and producer licences by state, with expiry alerts. |
| Product & compliance | Launch readiness | What each state still needs before it can be sold, and the go-live sign-offs. |
| Product & compliance | Statutory data | Premium and policy data by state, entity and benefit, reconciled to the premium records. |
| Product & compliance | Filing register | What is filed and approved, by state, with effective dates. |
| Product & compliance | Reference data | States, countries, regions, segments, prohibited destinations and tax tables, versioned. |
| Policies | Quotes | Priced and decided offers, with the versions they were made with. |
| Policies | Policies | One record per policy, with history and the record as it was at any date. |
| Policies | Agent changes | A weekly random sample of the changes the servicing agent made, to review. |
| Reports | Account reports | Sales, premium, take-up, cancellations and refunds by account, segment, state and benefit. |
| Billing | Premium records | A record for every bind, change and cancellation, with commission, tax and entity split. |
| Billing | Billing batches | Batches sent to the billing system, their control totals and confirmations. |
| Billing | Commission and programme rules | How each account’s commission and each card programme’s premium is calculated. |
| Documents | Document templates | Schedules and policies assembled from filed forms, checked and released by a second person. |
| Documents | Failed documents | Documents that could not be produced and emails that could not be delivered. |
| Underwriting | Eligibility check | Run a case through limits, sanctions screening, duplicate cover, referral rules, the waiver and CFAR. |
| Underwriting | Rule sets | Plan limits and referral rules per plan, with test cases and publishing. |
| Underwriting | Referrals | Cases referred to an underwriter and sanctions holds to review. |
| Underwriting | Sanctions lists | The OFAC list used to screen travellers, with approval. |
| Rating | Rate manuals | Filed manuals, their tables and formula, parity and publication. |
| Rating | Rating calculator | Rate a trip and see the full worksheet. |
| Card-linked cover | Card programmes | Issuer programmes, eligibility feeds and the eligibility ledger. |
| Card-linked cover | Master policies | Group policies issued to card issuers and banks. |
| Card-linked cover | Cover check | Was a cardholder covered for a trip? The answer claims staff use. |
| Operations | Events & deliveries | Business events, delivery status and the dead-letter queue. |
| AI agents | Copilot | Ask the Operations Copilot about accounts, events and the audit trail. |
| AI agents | Agent registry | Agents, their warrants, budgets, evaluations and kill switch. |
| AI agents | Agent reviews | Work that agents routed to people. |
| Settings | AI model connection | Set and test the key the AI agents use to call the model. |
| Governance | Audit trail | Tamper-evident record of every change and approval. |
| Governance | Feature flags | Release switches, globally or per account. |

## What your role may do

- Register accounts and change their status
- View accounts
- Approve agent versions and set warrants, budgets and evaluations
- Pause or resume an AI agent (kill switch)
- View AI agents, their warrants, runs and evaluations
- Review and resolve work routed from AI agents
- Ask AI agents for help within your own access
- View the audit trail
- Run audit-trail integrity verification
- Approve commission and programme rules made by someone else
- Confirm receipt of batches and the payment and refund of their records (the billing system)
- Create commission and programme rules, send batches, recalculate held records and retry
- View premium records, batches, commission rules and their status
- Load issuer eligibility feeds and reject held feeds
- Set up card programmes and master policies and take them live
- View card programmes, master policies, feeds and eligibility
- Read the policy and certificate data feed for claims
- Check whether a cardholder or traveller was covered on a date
- Run a load to the data platform
- View the data catalogue, the loads to the data platform and their files
- Assemble document templates, issue notices and guides, and retry failed deliveries
- View document templates, issued documents and their delivery
- Report what happened to documents that were sent (the delivery provider)
- Release document templates assembled by someone else, and resolve document quality findings
- View business events and their delivery status
- Replay dead-lettered event deliveries
- Record filings and their status by state
- View the filing register
- Change feature flags
- View feature flags
- Load form editions and edit or approve variable maps
- View filed forms, schedules and their variable maps
- View whether each state is ready to launch and who has signed
- Sign or withdraw the go-live approval for your own area
- Record and revoke travel retailer registrations and producer licences
- Create an account’s sandbox and issue its sandbox credentials
- Approve plan versions built by someone else and publish them
- Build plans, state variants and account plans, and their test cases
- View plans, their versions, comparisons and test results
- View policies, their history and their record at any date
- Submit proposals for forms, manuals and parity (used by agents acting for a person)
- View what agents have proposed for forms, manuals and parity
- Create quotes, change their selections and bind them to policies
- View quotes
- Change the optional benefits of one quote (held by a widget in a traveller’s browser; it cannot create or bind)
- Approve rate manuals loaded by someone else and publish them
- Load rate manuals and parity cases
- View rate manuals, parity results and rating worksheets, and rate trips
- Load reference data versions, and approve versions loaded by someone else
- View reference data and its versions
- Decide referrals and sanctions holds
- View sales, premium, take-up, cancellation and refund reports for the accounts you can see
- View and export statutory and statistical data by state, entity and benefit
- Preview and make changes, cancellations and corrections on policies
- Review the sample of changes made by the servicing agent
- Set, test and remove the key the AI agents use to call the model
- Assign work to other people and set how long each kind of work may wait
- See the work queue: referrals, agent proposals, agent reviews and failed deliveries, with their timers and owners
- Take work from the queue and hand it back
- Approve rule sets and sanctions lists loaded by someone else and publish rule sets
- Evaluate eligibility, record declarations and screen travellers
- Build rule sets and their test cases and load sanctions lists
- View rule sets, sanctions lists and referrals
- Create, pause and remove webhook subscriptions
- View webhook subscriptions
- Sign in to the operations workbench

## Rules everyone follows

- Where the platform asks for a second person, it will not accept your own approval.
- AI agents propose; people decide. Read what an agent shows before accepting it.
- Do not paste card numbers or social security numbers anywhere.
